sources.headline: India adds two wetlands; sites 2602 and 2603; tally 103
Announcement on 15 October 2026 by Bhupender Yadav; tally 103
Sukhna Lake, about 565 acres, Site 2602; India a party since 1 February 1982
Tally reaches 103 with Sukhna Wetland and Sauj Jheel, announced 15 October
